annotations.title: Validate an IBAN and its match to the payee's country

description:
Validates an IBAN (ISO 13616 format, length, MOD-97 checksum) and checks the account country matches the expected payee country.
Use when validating bank details on an invoice, confirming a payee's account change before paying, or checking for invoice redirection.
Inputs: iban; optional expectedCountry (ISO-2), payeeName, payeeTaxId (for ownership lookup in public registers).
Returns: valid, countryCode, checksumValid, countryMatch, ownershipVerified, issues[].
Sources: ISO 13616 rules; public registers. Same input → same output. $0.003 per call after 5 free calls/day; pay by card credits, x402: https://agentum.asimplek.cloud/pay

expectedCountry.description: Expected 2-letter ISO country code of the payee/vendor (e.g. 'DE')

iban.description: International Bank Account Number (IBAN), spaces permitted

payeeName.description: Optional legal payee name to cross-check against bank account jurisdiction

payeeTaxId.description: National tax/business registration number (e.g. Polish NIP or Czech IČO) to verify account ownership against official public registers

name: verify_bank_payee
